import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- All binary vectors of a given length. -/
def binVecs : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 => (binVecs n).map (fun v => 0 :: v) ++ (binVecs n).map (fun v => 1 :: v)

/-- Decidable check that `x` solves the system. -/
def chk (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range matrix.length).all (fun i =>
    ((List.range x.length).foldl
      (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0) % 2 == b.getD i 0)

/-- Search for the first element of a list satisfying a predicate. -/
def findSol (p : List Nat → Bool) : List (List Nat) → Option (List Nat)
  | [] => none
  | v :: rest => if p v = true then some v else findSol p rest
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  findSol (chk matrix b) (binVecs (matrix.getD 0 []).length)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma binVecs_length (n : Nat) : ∀ v ∈ binVecs n, v.length = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro v h
    simp [binVecs] at h
    simp [h]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v h
    simp only [binVecs, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at h
    rcases h with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ <;> simp [ih w hw]

lemma binVecs_mem (n : Nat) :
    ∀ v : List Nat, v.length = n → (∀ y, y ∈ v → y = 0 ∨ y = 1) → v ∈ binVecs n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro v hl _
    cases v with
    | nil => simp [binVecs]
    | cons a t => simp at hl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hl hb
    cases v with
    | nil => simp at hl
    | cons a t =>
      have hlt : t.length = k := by simpa using hl
      have ht : t ∈ binVecs k := ih t hlt (fun y hy => hb y (by simp [hy]))
      have ha := hb a (by simp)
      simp only [binVecs, List.mem_append, List.mem_map]
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩

lemma chk_iff (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) :
    chk matrix b x = true ↔
      (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
        ((List.range x.length).foldl
          (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0) % 2 = b.getD i 0) := by
  simp [chk]

lemma findSol_some (p : List Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List (List Nat)) (v : List Nat), findSol p l = some v → v ∈ l ∧ p v = true := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro v h; simp [findSol] at h
  | cons c t ih =>
    intro v h
    simp only [findSol] at h
    by_cases hc : p c = true
    · rw [if_pos hc] at h
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst h
      exact ⟨by simp, hc⟩
    · rw [if_neg hc] at h
      exact ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih v h).1, (ih v h).2⟩

lemma findSol_none (p : List Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List (List Nat)), findSol p l = none → ∀ v ∈ l, p v = false := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ v hv; simp at hv
  | cons c t ih =>
    intro h v hv
    simp only [findSol] at h
    by_cases hc : p c = true
    · rw [if_pos hc] at h
      exact absurd h (by simp)
    · rw [if_neg hc] at h
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'
      · simpa using hc
      · exact ih h v hv'
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond_satisfied (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases h : solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond with
  | none =>
    have h' : findSol (chk matrix b) (binVecs (matrix.getD 0 []).length) = none := h
    show ∀ x : List Nat, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length →
      (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
    intro x hlen hbin hsol
    obtain ⟨hl2, h2⟩ := hsol
    have hmem : x ∈ binVecs (matrix.getD 0 []).length :=
      binVecs_mem _ x hlen hbin
    have hc1 : chk matrix b x = false :=
      findSol_none (chk matrix b) _ h' x hmem
    have hc2 : chk matrix b x = true := (chk_iff matrix b x).mpr h2
    simp [hc1] at hc2
  | some x =>
    have h' : findSol (chk matrix b) (binVecs (matrix.getD 0 []).length) = some x := h
    show is_solution matrix b x
    obtain ⟨hmem, hchk⟩ := findSol_some (chk matrix b) _ x h'
    exact ⟨binVecs_length _ x hmem, (chk_iff matrix b x).mp hchk⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
